stories.headline: Scott Colom takes a Senate seat in Mississippi
stories.summary: Scott Colom, a Democratic district attorney, has won a United States Senate seat in Mississippi. He defeated the Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith in what was considered an upset, after more than a week of ballot counting. He is the first African American senator elected in the state since 1874.

stories.headline: Sudan lifts its ban on tea from Kenya
stories.summary: Sudan has agreed to lift its ban on imports of tea from Kenya, which had stood for 20 months. The deal was signed by the Kenyan president, William Ruto.

stories.headline: A car boot sixpence carries a minting mystery
stories.summary: A silver sixpence issued during the reign of King William IV was found in an album of coins at a car boot sale in Greater Manchester. Researchers have now measured the damage to its portrait side, where the difference between the highest and lowest points reaches about 0.75 millimetres.
